title: NPFEEGNet-RD: maintained implementation and audit evidence
description: NPFEEGNet-RD version 0.5.0: independently maintained EEG model, training and inference workflow, with experiment configurations, anonymous prediction-level evidence and portable audits. Validation includes 22 tests, byte-identical re-export of six OpenBMI input files, one subject/seed NPF source-selection/fitting/inference run, and four short baseline integration runs. This is not a full rerun of all manuscript experiments or a demonstration of numerical equivalence to the historical engine. Raw EEG, trained weights and the EEG-CSANet-derived legacy training engine are excluded. Project-owned code is Apache-2.0; included third-party components retain their own notices, including the pinned MIT-licensed FBCNet source. See LICENSE_SCOPE.md and THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md.
